# Checked links

Every link, image, heading anchor and diagram target is checked: broken ones
are marked on the page while you write, and `devpage check` fails on them.

<Terminal>

```
$ devpage check docs
docs/README.md:3: broken link design.md — no such file
```

</Terminal>

Teaches it: [Checking links](../boxes/viewer/checking-links/README.md).
